# CANDIDATE: VWAP_DEVIATION_RSI_MEANREV_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price reverts to VWAP after exceeding one ATR deviation when RSI is extreme (<30) and the EMA ribbon is bullish (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55), offering a mean-reversion edge in low-volatility regimes (VIX <15). This exploits short-term exhaustion after extended moves away from VWAP, distinct from continuation strategies.

## Mechanism

Entry: When close > 1×ATR(14) above VWAP, RSI(14) < 30, EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55, and time between 09:45-11:30 EST, enter long at bar's close. Exit: Chart-stop at most recent swing low, TP1 at 1.5R (risk-reward), runner trailed 15% below highest high since entry. Avoid first 30 min after open and lunch-hour chop (11:30-13:30); require VIX <15.
